description: A metal stamp carrying an engraved or sunk device on its face, set in a wooden handle and heated for impressing patterns into a cover. Blind versions are cut like a seal so the recessed area prints the design, while gold versions print from the raised surface.
name: finishing tool

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XIV, p.188. Internet Archive.
